leadText: Lisa Adams is an American voice actress who was one of the original voice actresses for the English-language dub of . She is currently affiliated with DDO Artists Agency.
plainText:
Lisa Adams is an American voice actress who was one of the original voice actresses for the English-language dub of . She is currently affiliated with DDO Artists Agency.

==Biography==
Adams was born in Joplin, Missouri, and became a voice actress as an adult. She joined during season six, and remained in the cast until its dubbing production was taken over by and TAJ Productions. Adams returned to the cast in The Power of Us, where she voiced Townes.
